supported_positive_finding: The frozen 4-class detector significantly reduces false-elephant image alarms on external no-elephant multi-animal scenes relative to the original elephant-only detector.
dominant_negative_finding: The false-alarm reduction is accompanied by a large statistically supported loss of elephant sensitivity/recall/F1, so the current 4-class model is not supported as a replacement detector.
confuser_error_finding: A significant improvement in animal-confuser-to-elephant overlap error rate was not demonstrated.
supplementary_lion_finding: The 9-image elephant+lion challenge is small and does not establish broad in-vocabulary robustness.
future_model_rule: If a new mixed-species detector is trained or tuned after R17, the current frozen COCO 453 evaluation set must be treated as seen/evaluated and must not be described as a pristine untouched external test for that new model. A fresh untouched external test set is required for confirmatory claims.
manuscript_claim_rule: Report R17 as a robustness stress test showing a selectivity-vs-sensitivity trade-off and a current detector limitation. Do not claim universal mixed-species robustness, unseen-species robustness, or end-to-end operational validation.
